result.title: How many mistakes does it take to learn an interval? Exact Littlestone dimensions of intervals and their unions
result.comment: 33 pages, 11 figures, 5 tables. Code and Lean 4 proofs: https://github.com/researchbackup27-sudo/exact-littlestone-intervals
result.summary: The Littlestone dimension of a hypothesis class equals the smallest number of mistakes an online learner can guarantee against an adaptive adversary. For discrete intervals and unions of $j$ intervals on $m$ points, only its order of growth was known. We determine it exactly. For every switch budget $k$ (with both end labels fixed when $k$ is odd), the smallest size on which $d$ mistakes can be forced follows a three-regime law: $d+1$ while $d\le k$, then $2d-k+1$, and beyond $d=\lceil 3k/2\rceil+k-1$ doubling the size adds exactly $k$ mistakes. Unions of $j$ intervals on $m$ points correspond to $k=2j$ and size $m+1$, and a single interval gives the thresholds $1,2,3,5,7,10,14,20,\dots$. The natural learner that waits for a positive example and binary-searches both endpoints is not optimal: it can be forced into one extra mistake for 50,847 of the domain sizes below $10^5$. Upper bounds come from a gap potential and a block-pairing learner, and lower bounds from adversary strategies and a refinement step. These tools give an explicit optimal learner with $O(\log m)$ time per round, which on random streams makes more mistakes on average than the natural learner. For randomised learners, we compute the randomised Littlestone dimension of thresholds exactly and prove that a greedy adversary forces an explicit closed-form number of expected mistakes on intervals; this bound is within $0.64$ of optimal and, we conjecture, exact (confirmed for $m\le70$). Exact computation tests every result, and the formulas for every switch budget are machine-checked in Lean 4.

AI.brief_summary: 论文精确求出离散区间及 j 个区间并集的 Littlestone 维数，给出随 switch budget 分三段增长的闭式公式，构造可达最优的块配对学习器与对抗下界，并给出随机化情形的部分精确结果与 Lean 4 机器验证。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「对抗序列下最少被迫犯错数」可视为对需要多少证据才能定论的容量刻画，可能与 LVR 中的证据获取与停止决策的信息量估算相关；「自然二分学习器并非最优」这一现象可供核查是否类比启发式 LOOK 策略的次优性，但该文为纯学习理论、无多模态设置，联系较远。
